## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. State the supported scope.

## Validation

- [ ] `sh tools/test.sh` (Linux) or `./tools/Test-Project.ps1` (Windows) passes offline.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and changelog are updated.
- [ ] Examples, fixtures and reports contain no real credentials or business data.

For protocol changes, distinguish synthetic tests from live evidence and name
the exact server build when applicable. Do not attach raw authentication captures.
